Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman.

a deep ebony-brown complexion, late 20s goddess, hourglass bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once, top bun chocolate brown hair — wearing a skin-tight ultra-high-cut micro swimsuit of ultra-thin glossy cobalt-blue PVC, made of two small triangle cups held by a single strap over her left shoulder, her right shoulder and right arm bare, joined to the bottom by one narrow diagonal strap of the same PVC that runs from the cups across her stomach to her right hip, a short closed zipper running along the diagonal strap with the zipper teeth visible, her waist sides, her flanks, her stomach and the skin around the straps bare, the bottom is only a small triangle at the front cut extremely high up to the very top of her hip bones, her hips, thighs and legs completely bare, the PVC shrink-wrapped onto her body like a second skin, fully opaque, her arms bare, her face and hands bare. Real photographic skin on her face, neck, arms, hands, stomach, thighs and legs, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, faint freckles on her chest V and the backs of her hands and a small beauty mark near her lips. Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, platform stiletto ballet boots made of glossy cobalt-blue PVC, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.

Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Black woman with strong, striking features, a broad nose and full lips, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: bright pastel pink and yellow eyeshadow, thick lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, small star and heart shapes painted on the cheeks only, glossy candy-pink lips.

Background: the famous scramble crossing of Shibuya at night with towering video-screen buildings and glowing signs; her giant stiletto heel stands in the foreground like a monument, with hundreds of tiny pedestrians with umbrellas and phones, tiny taxis waiting with glowing headlights gathered in a crowd around the base of the heel, every person at their true real size and only as tall as the heel is long, all looking up at it; she is a colossal giant, her towering heels planted on the crossing asphalt, her body rising high above the crowd and the buildings, a deep dark-blue night sky behind her, the whole scene clearly visible and in focus, lit by the neon glow on her skin and the colorful city lights with gentle shadows. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from ground level with the camera low among the crowd and tilted upward, her giant stiletto shoe and its slender heel large in the foreground at the bottom of the frame, the whole figure from the heel tips up to the top of her head completely visible rising far above the crowd, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph.
